methodology.normalization: Conservative full-candidate percentile: count strictly lower / finite population × 100; ties share a percentile; singleton = 50.
methodology.tdSuccess: Empirical-Bayes conversion = (rushing+receiving TD + league TD/opportunity × 20) / (scorer opportunities + 20).
methodology.positionAdjustment: Player usage is divided by the candidate-position mean; opponent positional TD rate is divided by the league mean allowed to that position before full-population normalization.
